description_en: Starts a robocall task immediately or at a scheduled time
description_zh: 启动智能语音任务或者定时启动智能语音任务
name: StartRobotTask

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the robocall task. You can call the [CreateRobotTask](~~CreateRobotTask~~) operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。可通过[CreateRobotTask](~~CreateRobotTask~~)接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The time scheduled for starting the robocall task, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 定时启动时间。格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: schedule_time
